# CorrelationIdScope

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Diagnostics.CorrelationIdScope`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Ambient correlation-ID scope shared by the CLI, the RPC daemon, and every Dataverse service called from either surface.

Capture source: `a0feb138f00575d35634565f3a733deb9e65ca98`, tree `904cce706d298d3f0ed62ea095bdcdd78d584101` (final-C Release candidate; not a published stable package).

## Members

### Methods

#### Push

```text
public static System.IDisposable Push(System.String correlationId)
```

Establishes a correlation-id scope for the lifetime of the returned System.IDisposable. The previous value is restored on dispose so nested scopes (e.g., CLI entry → per-RPC-call) behave correctly.

- Parameter `correlationId`: The correlation id to install. A or whitespace value is treated as &quot;clear the slot&quot; for this scope.

Returns: A disposable handle that restores the previous value.

#### NewId

```text
public static System.String NewId()
```

Generates a new GUID-based correlation id (lowercase hyphenated form). Callers should prefer PPDS.Dataverse.Diagnostics.CorrelationIdScope.Push(System.String) to install a value; this helper exists so CLI entrypoints can seed the initial id without duplicating the format string.
